longDescription: Reef Support B.V. was founded in Delft in 2020 by two TU Delft graduates and won the ESA Copernicus Masters Overall Prize the same year. The company develops open AI models for coral reef image analysis, mangrove and blue carbon monitoring methods, and earth observation workflows for coastal water quality, and runs them in projects with partners who hold the field presence and measurement assets. Its work includes a coral restoration lab in Lombok built with Indonesia Biru Foundation, 3D photogrammetry for reef restoration in Colombia supported by WWF Netherlands, and open AI challenges with FruitPunch AI, Sustainable Ocean Alliance and OceanHub Africa.
